'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a quest-exclusive NPC that first appears in {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}. 

During the evacuation, in the {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}, it was said he awakened as a Resonator. He's recovering at Xuanfang Huaxu Academy hospital and helping out.

;During {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}
:'''Zhenshu:''' How's that boy Qingyan doing?

:'''Zhenshu: '''Thank goodness... If not for that power, he and his sister would have fallen from the cliff.
